u:about_text: Nakhlio helps expats settle in Medina: housing, transport, services and a community that answers your questions. Every apartment is checked in person and photographed by our team.
u:majlis_tag: Ask — people who’ve done it will answer
u:rules_text: The Majlis is where we help each other live in Medina. Politics, criticism of the authorities and religious disputes are not allowed here. Why: under Saudi law, responsibility for such posts lies not only with the author but with the site too. One such message could get Nakhlio closed, and everyone would lose a place to ask and get help. So we kindly ask: only useful experience, questions and advice. Messages that break the rules are hidden. If you see one, tap “Report”.
